hero.title: Hello! I'm Bryan, a frontend software engineer.
descriptions: I'm a passionate developer specializing in building intuitive, dynamic web and mobile experiences. With professional expertise in React, React Native, and TypeScript, I create applications that seamlessly combine functionality and elegance.

From crafting live class platforms for hundreds of users to developing fintech solutions that boost engagement, I thrive on turning ideas into impactful, user-centered products. Clean code, attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous improvement are at the core of my work.
I'm currently looking for part time opportunities and excitng projects to collaborate on. Hire me?

paragraphs: I work on large-scale frontend systems where consistency and maintainability are critical. My focus has been on reducing technical and UI fragmentation by unifying codebases, design systems, and build workflows. I help teams turn complex, messy interfaces into calm, predictable experiences that scale across products and markets. Much of my work sits at the intersection of frontend architecture, UI quality, and long-term product health.

I helped ship and scale multiple consumer-facing products in fintech and education, taking features from early concepts to production. The role required balancing speed with quality while working on real-time systems, mobile apps, and internal tools. I developed a strong product mindset here, learning how to make complex workflows feel intuitive and reliable for users.

I was brought in to improve usability and reduce frontend technical debt in a growing product. My work focused on simplifying onboarding flows, clarifying dashboards, and refactoring brittle components. The goal was to make the product easier to use and easier for the team to maintain.

I supported multiple product teams by strengthening testing processes and improving product reliability. I worked on test documentation, automated key user flows, and partnered closely with engineers to catch issues early. This role gave me a strong foundation in quality, edge cases, and user empathy — perspectives that continue to shape how I build frontend features today.

Achieved Magna Cum Laude honors Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, reflecting dedication to academic excellence and proficiency in subject matter. Led the creation of multiple projects, gaining practical skills and mastering modern technologies in the field.

projects.title: Selected projects
projects.subtitle: Here are some side projects I've worked on

projects.title: Todify • Todo List
projects.imageAlt: To do application for creating todos with a white background and salmon interface
projects.description: Built a user-friendly todo list app using React and Tailwind CSS. Integrated IndexedDB for local storage, allowing users to create, mark as done, and delete tasks directly in their browsers. Simplifies task management with an intuitive interface for efficient organization.

projects.title: Blackjack • Blackjack quick game
projects.imageAlt: Blackjack application menu screenshot with three pixelated cards as a logo and buttons to start playing
projects.description: Developed a simple blackjack game using React, Tailwind CSS, React i18next and API calls. Allows playing against a CPU dealer, betting the amount of chips you want, and having preferences like changing the table color and language.
